en.title: TicketValidationService V2.1: incorrect NMTOKEN identifier case
en.short: The PDF names the CurrentTripRef type as IBIS-IP.NMToken; the authoritative V2.1 XSD uses only IBIS-IP.NMTOKEN.

en.recommendation: Use the exact XSD spelling IBIS-IP.NMTOKEN for implementation and code generation. Treat the PDF spelling as documentation-only and do not normalize or accept it as an alias.

de.title: TicketValidationService V2.1: inkonsistenter SubscribeCurrentStop-Operationsname in der PDF
de.short: Die formalen PDF-Abschnitte verwenden SubscribeCurrentStopPoint, während der deutsche und englische Ablauftext SubscribeCurrentStop nennt.
de.long: Die offizielle V2.1-PDF bezeichnet die Operation im Inhaltsverzeichnis, in beiden formalen Operationsübersichten und im Detailabschnitt als SubscribeCurrentStopPoint. Der deutsche und englische Ablauftext verwendet dagegen SubscribeCurrentStop. de.recommendation: Den Ablauftext als PDF-Dokumentationsfehler behandeln und bei der Interpretation des Dokuments die wiederholte formale Bezeichnung SubscribeCurrentStopPoint heranziehen. Aus diesem Befund keinerlei ausführbare V2.1-XSD-Operation und keinen Alias erfinden.

en.title: TicketValidationService V2.1: inconsistent SubscribeCurrentStop operation name in the PDF
en.short: Formal PDF sections use SubscribeCurrentStopPoint while the German and English flow text uses SubscribeCurrentStop.
en.long: The official V2.1 PDF names the operation SubscribeCurrentStopPoint in the table of contents, both formal operation overviews, and the detailed operation section. The German and English flow text instead use SubscribeCurrentStop. The alternative hypothesis of a second or legacy formal operation is not supported by the repeated formal naming in the same document. Crucially, the EV-150 correction establishes that the exact V2.1 TicketValidationService XSD contains neither SubscribeCurrentStopPoint nor SubscribeCurrentStop as a local service operation or global element. The finding is therefore solely a PDF-internal editorial inconsistency.
en.recommendation: Treat the flow-text spelling as a PDF documentation defect and use the repeatedly formal SubscribeCurrentStopPoint name when interpreting the document. Do not invent an executable V2.1 XSD operation or alias from this finding.
